_comment: Copy the entries you need into .devin/mcp_config.json (everyone who clones), .devin/mcp_config.local.json (just you, gitignored), or the user-level mcp_config.json (every project on this machine). Secrets are written as ${env:VAR} (your shell) or ${file:~/path} (a file); never paste a token here. Which model each entry is (A laptop, B shared, C team-hosted, D vendor) and what to ask first: integrations/mcp-hosting.md. Only reference-system works offline.

reference-system._comment: Model A. Local process, standard library only, reads example-system/ only. Already registered in .devin/mcp_config.json.

jira-readonly._comment: Model A or B. Read-only Jira Data Center connector (github.com/COG-GTM/jira-mcp), seven GET-only tools, project allowlist; walkthrough in jira-on-prem.md option 6. Docker form, mirrors that repo's devin-desktop.example.json: clone it, `docker build -t onprem-jira-mcp:latest .` there first. Docker forwards only the variables named with -e, so args and env must agree. Basic auth: replace the JIRA_TOKEN pair in args and the JIRA_TOKEN entry in env with JIRA_USERNAME and JIRA_PASSWORD and set JIRA_AUTH_MODE to basic. Private CA: add `-e JIRA_CA_BUNDLE -v /path/on/laptop/ca.pem:/certs/ca.pem:ro` to args and JIRA_CA_BUNDLE=/certs/ca.pem to env. Without Docker: command python3, args ["-m", "connector.server"], started from the jira-mcp directory after pip install -r requirements.txt (running connector/server.py by path fails: relative imports). Needs outbound HTTPS to your Jira host. Remove this block if not approved.

github-readonly._comment: Model A or B. github/github-mcp-server binary on PATH, read-only toolsets. Needs outbound HTTPS to GITHUB_HOST. Remove this block if not approved.

team-hosted._comment: Model C. A server your platform team runs on an internal host; Devin connects over HTTPS, nothing is installed on the laptop. Static token per user shown here; for single sign-on delete 'headers' and run 'devin mcp login team-hosted'. Needs administrator approval, network reach to the host, and a TLS certificate the laptop trusts. Not run in this repository. Remove this block if not approved.

vendor-hosted._comment: Model D. The vendor runs the server on the internet; sign in with 'devin mcp login vendor-hosted' (browser). Requests leave your network. Needs administrator approval and an answer on the authorization boundary. Not run in this repository. Remove this block if not approved.
